name: Secrets of Avalon
source:
Explore the Great Covenant of Avalon, a gathering of allied representatives on their home planet, as Dere Aislinn; a girl who lost her memory at the same place three years ago. Were your memory loss to be discovered it would be at great strain to your family.

Without getting caught, uncover the mystery of your amnesia while navigating between politics and romance. Evade political, social, and sometimes physical dangers to regain what you’ve lost or choose to move beyond your forgotten history. Aid in the exploration of an ancient archaeological site while putting Avalon’s political stability at risk or help maintain the current status quo. While maybe along the way finding life-long friends or unexpected romance…

[From [url=https://suru.itch.io/secrets-of-avalon]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演Dere Aislinn，探索阿瓦隆大盟会。这场盛会将各盟友的代表聚集在他们的母星上，而你在三年前，正是在同一个地方失去了记忆。一旦失忆之事被人发现，你的家族将承受极大的压力。

周旋于政治与爱情之间，在无人察觉的情况下揭开失忆之谜。避开政治、社交，有时甚至危及人身安全的险境，找回失去的一切，或选择放下那段遗忘的过去。你可以协助探索一处古老的考古遗址，却让阿瓦隆的政局面临动荡，也可以帮助维持现状。也许在这段旅程中，你还能结交一生的挚友，或邂逅意想不到的爱情……

[摘自[url=https://suru.itch.io/secrets-of-avalon]Itch.io[/url]]
